failed_hard_gates.evidence: At 512 px a woman handles a blue book at the shelf; native pixels show its cover beside upright spines but do not expose a receiving gap or prove that it is entering rather than being held or removed.
The sideboard is visible at both scales. A small thin rectangular outline appears on top at native size, but it does not read as a recent book-sized cleared patch, and it is barely legible at 512 px.
A throw drapes over the sofa arm at both scales, but it reads as ordinary finished decor; a half-folded pending tidy task is not distinguishable.
Fingers contact the blue cover, but the fore-edge and empty receiving gap are not independently visible; halfway insertion cannot be confirmed at native size.
The wider view now shows her feet and room, but the book-to-gap relationship stays too small at 512 px and ambiguous at native size.

boundary: This audit validates recorded pixel-review evidence and, when applicable, user acceptance; it does not infer visual truth from metadata, authenticate who authored a review, or declare moe on the user's behalf.
